rv.q: 5/5 stars! A sui generis meditation on time and existence, a classical choral masterwork infused with pop, blues and gospel.
I felt instead the kind of awe I feel in cathedrals, where the architecture itself forces one's thoughts upward and outward.
Christian smashes through that old prejudice of mine.
This collision of classical music, experimental theater, and theoretical physics generates so much creative energy, it feels like it could power every theater in New York.
After 24 months of isolation and loss, there's a miraculous feel to this new music-theater piece.
